'''Rie Kugimiya''' (Japanese: '''釘宮理恵''' ''Kugimiya Rie'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Kugimiya was born on May 30, 1979 in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She began her work during {{aniseries|GS}}, where she mostly voiced [[character of the day|characters of the day]]. However, she gained two major roles during its {{pkmn|movie}}s: {{OBP|Celebi|M13}} in the [[M13|thirteenth movie]] and Confined {{an|Hoopa}} in the [[M18|eighteenth movie]], respectively. Later, during {{aniseries|SM}}, Kugimiya's major role was [[Ida]]. Kugimiya is currently affiliated with the talent group {{wp|I'm Enterprise}} and was nominated as Best Leading Actress during the {{wp|1st Seiyu Awards}}.
